name: protection-backup-readiness
description: Backup readiness check: list mountable backup target volumes and the categories of user data that will be backed up (documents, wallets, keys, browser profile). Read-only. NOTE: running an actual encrypted backup needs your passphrase, which the dashboard Backup tab provides - workflows cannot prompt for it.
